`spe/evals/harness/grader.js` (changed part):

```js
function normPriority(v) {
  return String(v ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
}

function scorePriority(expected, actual) {
  const a = normPriority(actual);
  if (a === '') return 0;
  return normPriority(expected) === a ? 1 : 0;
}
```

`spe/evals/harness/grader.selftest.js` (added cases):
```js

assert.equal(scorePriority('P1', 'p1'), 1, 'lowercase oracle passes');

assert.equal(scorePriority('P1', 'P2'), 0, 'wrong priority fails');
assert.equal(scorePriority('P1', ''), 0, 'empty fails');
assert.equal(scorePriority('P1', null), 0, 'missing fails');
```
